game.name: Isekai: I'm an FPS Hero Who Was Summoned to Another World

items.text: First of all, thank you for all the feedback.
We carefully read your comments, suggestions, and gameplay impressions.
In this update, we mainly focused on improving gameplay comfort and overall quality of life.
• Key rebinding has been added
You can now fully customize controls and remap keys to your own preferences.
• You can now freely look around while dashing
• Jump height has been increased
If you still haven’t tried the game, now is a great moment to jump in.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538251/1d13a29849bd8cb00cc5285149c2c79e5d0c779a.png"]
You can grab the full version or try the demo and experiment with the first available combinations of demonic cores and weapons.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3621480/Anime_FPS_Guns_vs_Magic_Demo/"]

releases.displayName: Update – New Content and Major Gameplay Changes

items.text: This update focuses on new content and overall quality of life improvements. We took your feedback very seriously and used it to introduce significant changes to the core gameplay.

The game is now more accessible, but that does not mean less is happening, quite the opposite. The gameplay remains intense, while giving the player more control and more meaningful decisions during combat.
As announced, elements now play a key role in gameplay.
The tutorial has also been updated, so we recommend starting a new game to fully experience all the new mechanics.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538251/68ca43aae67b8d6161ed311c8647e23387685fca.png"]
• Poison element cores have been added. New enemies related to this element have also appeared. These cores can be applied to weapons, causing bullets to poison enemies for a few seconds.

notes.title: • New weapon types have been added

items.text: Shotgun – short range, high damage, perfect for eliminating multiple enemies at once
Sniper rifle – slower, but with very long range
The sniper rifle features a deliberately modified zoom system that helps maintain awareness during fast-paced combat.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538251/86d6ec6a860fd513d8a04e15e5f7a9954b8dae6b.png"]
• New blessing: Magnet – after completing a goddess task, dropped cores are automatically pulled toward the player
• Grinding portals have been added. During officer fights, you can descend into Nymaria to farm cores
• Hall of Glory (NEW!)
Unlocked after defeating the first officer. Allows you to fight any enemy at a chosen level, making it an ideal place to test weapons
• Core upgrade system has been added, allowing you to upgrade cores to higher levels (unlocked during gameplay)
• New enemy: Water Elemental
• In Nymaria, you can now return to the Pantheon and regenerate
(Note: bosses also regenerate, but this can be a good moment to change your strategy)
• Added new on-screen notifications (level ups, blessings, etc.)
• Domain shields with icons now appear above goddess areas to improve navigation
• The tutorial has been slightly reworked to make the early missions easier to get into
(yes, the demon boss has changed its element)
• Elements now have a major impact on combat
At Kana, you can find a guide showing which elements are effective against others
• Officers do not have assigned elements, so player skill and understanding enemy behavior still matter most
• Normal and Blessed difficulty levels have been slightly reduced
• The pistol now fires faster starting from rank E
• Scene transitions have been improved (no more “white screens”)
• The starting location has been completely redesigned
(the previous anime-style reference was confusing for some players)

notes.title: • Removing a weapon from inventory now returns

items.text: the loaded core
50% of the weapon’s value
• Nymaria optimization improvements

notes.title: • In the local shop, you can now exchange all cores for

items.text: white cores
coins
• Increased mission rewards, giving more cores and currency
• The game now features a cohesive, dedicated soundtrack created specifically for the game by a single composer
• Portal colors have been updated
• Improved visibility of direction indicators (pointers)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538251/1fdb9a36b4cd2e423dab2a6c8ed0dfd3c61705b9.png"]
New missions and quests will be added in the next update.
Combat encounters and locations are already prepared, and we are currently polishing animations and final details.
With this update, we have replaced the game’s visuals and logo, moving from a temporary AI version to our own original designs.
If you haven’t picked up the game yet, now is a great time.
The goddesses are waiting to meet you
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3553190/Isekai_Im_an_FPS_Hero_who_was_summoned_to_another_world/"]

items.text: White Core Nerf: Reduced the defensive power when slotted into weapons.
Little Bears Fixed: These cute troublemakers now deal proper damage again.
Boss & Officer Balance: Slightly adjusted combat difficulty to improve pacing.
Pantheon Candle Textures: Fixed texture issues for candle models.
Name Localization: Improved character name localization across the game.
Thanks for playing, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Battle Against the First Demon Lord Officer

items.text: You can now face the strongest enemy in the demo to date – the First Officer of the Demon Lord. We’ve teased him before, and now the time has come. The fight is fast-paced, intense, and action-packed – a true test of your reflexes and skill.
Before entering the portal to fight either the Demon Boss (returning from earlier versions) or the Officer, you'll now choose your difficulty:
🔹 Normal
🔹 Hard
Your choice affects the challenge… and the reward.
By popular demand, we’ve added a save system! Now you can keep your progress and try different approaches without losing everything.
We’ve updated the shooting mechanics – it’s now faster, smoother, and more responsive. Every weapon feels better to use.
We’ve replaced some tracks and added original compositions.
Thanks for your support, feedback, and suggestions – the game keeps getting better because of you!
Let us know how you fared against the new boss, and which difficulty you chose!
Add the game to your wishlist, follow us on Steam, and join our Discord to stay updated and hang out with the devs and community!

items.text: – Fixed a few glitches & text issues
– Reload exploit patched: you can’t switch weapons mid-reload to refill ammo anymore 🔫
Thanks for playing! 💬

Thank you so much for all the feedback after the first update – it’s been incredibly helpful! Based on your input, we’ve prepared a new set of changes to make the gameplay more dynamic and enjoyable. Here’s what’s new:
🐻 More action!
– Boss fights are now more intense and dynamic.
– Additional enemies now appear along the routes between objectives.
– Extra bears spawn in villages during the boss encounter.
🔫 Combat and balance improvements
– Enemies that are resistant to a specific elemental weapon now display shield indicators when hit.
– It is no longer possible to kill enemies through portals.
– The pistol is now set to single-shot mode, as originally intended.
– Fixed a bug that caused slow firing speed for the pistol on some systems.
– Weapon range rebalanced (pistol and rifle).
🗺️ UI and dialogue improvements
– Goddess portraits now appear during their mission-related dialogue.
– Side dialogues take up less space on screen.
– Most dialogues can now be skipped.
– Objective locators are more visible and easier to follow.
– Shop and weapon loading tutorial has been improved – clearer and more helpful.
🏃‍♂️ Player parameter balance
– Adjusted values for: height, stamina, jump, and dash.
And this is just the beginning – more updates are on the way! 🚀
If you haven’t already, add the game to your wishlist – and don’t forget to join our Discord to share feedback, chat with other players, and stay up to date! 💬
👉 Thanks for being with us – together, we’re building this world!
Thank you to everyone who played Isekai: I'm an FPS Hero and shared their thoughts with us! 💌 Your feedback is invaluable – here’s what we’ve already improved:
🔤 Fixed fonts – special characters in various languages (e.g., Ukrainian) now display correctly.
⚙️ New settings menu! – we’ve added basic options: Audio, Quality, and Keymapping (currently view-only – key remapping will come in a future update!).
🔫 Faster pistol firing – the early-game combat feels more dynamic.
🗿 Fixed stone projectiles – rocks thrown by the cute-but-deadly bears no longer roll on the ground and deal unintended damage.
💎 Easier core collection – no more jumping to collect floating cores – just walk underneath them.
❤️ Bigger enemy health bars – improved visibility during combat.
⚡ Faster stamina regeneration – more action, less waiting.
👹 Nymaria boss updated – on your second visit to the region, the boss will now notice you faster and summon reinforcements more quickly. No more easy sniping from afar!
This is just the beginning – more updates are on the way! Thank you for your continued support and please keep sharing your thoughts – we're building this world together! 🌍✨
